findings.title: Migration fails if embed_category is unset and does not normalize old hosts
findings.body: The query to find category_id from embed_category assumes a matching row exists. If the setting is blank or no category name matches, the result set is empty and `[0]['id']` raises NoMethodError, causing the migration to fail on fresh installs or when embed_category was never configured. Additionally, old host values are inserted directly into the new table via raw SQL without trimming scheme/path. The new model's `before_validation` trims these, but raw insertion bypasses that, so hosts like 'http://example.com' will be stored with scheme and will never match `record_for_host`, breaking embedding for migrated sites.

findings.title: Category and embeddable_host fabricator definitions are swapped
findings.body: The file `category_fabricator.rb` now contains `Fabricator(:embeddable_host)`, while the new `embeddable_host_fabricator.rb` contains the original `Fabricator(:category)` definitions. This means tests requiring `spec/fabricators/category_fabricator` will load the wrong fabricator, and the `:category` fabricator will be missing, causing many tests to fail with 'No fabricator registered for :category'. The definitions need to be placed in the correct files.

findings.title: Controller does not handle missing record or parameters, causing 500 errors
findings.body: In `update`, if the host ID is not found, `host` is nil and `save_host(host)` will call `host.host = ...`, raising NoMethodError. Similarly, `destroy` calls `host.destroy` on nil. Additionally, `save_host` assumes `params[:embeddable_host]` and its subkeys `:host` and `:category_id` exist; if any are missing, it raises NoMethodError. These should be guarded with 404/422 responses.

findings.title: before_validation crashes when host is nil
findings.body: The callback uses `self.host.sub!(/^https?:///, '')`, which calls `sub!` on nil if `host` is nil. This can happen when creating an EmbeddableHost without a host (e.g., from a form missing the field) and will raise NoMethodError. The callback should guard against nil, for example by using `self.host = self.host.to_s.sub(/^https?:\/\//, '')` or checking presence first.
